summary:
I'm an electro-mechanical engineer and a leader specializing in product development, manufacturing, and industrial automation. I am someone who is quick to pick up, apply, and integrate new technologies. I bring together mechanical design, electronics, controls, software, and manufacturing to develop reliable products and systems built for real-world use.

That same curiosity extends beyond my professional work into traveling the world, rebuilding cars, replicating movie props, and finding creative ways to automate the repetitive parts of my everyday life. RileyBeenders.com is another extension of that curiosity. I built it to document my professional experience and projects. Right now, it's helping me apply to ambitious opportunities. Over time, I'll keep building it out to show the full range of what I can offer!
